chunks: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another; and if a heavily laden soul calls out for help, none will carry of its load, even if he be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord in secret and establish prayer. And whoever purifies himself does so for his own soul. And to Allah is the return.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'no bearer of burdens bears another's load' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Fatir establishes the foundational principle of 'individual accountability' (Mas'uliyyah al-Fardi), clarifying that while one may benefit from another's prayers or charity, the burden of sin remains strictly personal and is not transferred even to close kin. It underscores that true spiritual purification (Tazkiyah) is an internal, self-directed process, making the individual the primary agent of their own moral and spiritual destiny before returning to Allah.
